metaTitle: Custom Frosted Lanyards Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom frosted lanyards and badges for a sleek, matte look. Perfect for events and corporate ID. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Frosted lanyards and badges offer a subtle, matte finish that reduces glare and adds a modern, professional touch to your employee IDs or event credentials. Unlike standard glossy options, the frosted surface resists fingerprints and smudges, keeping your branding looking clean throughout daily use. Ideal for trade shows, conferences, or corporate offices where a sophisticated, non-reflective appearance matters.
heroAltText: Bulk custom frosted lanyards and badges with matte finish for corporate ID and events
